verdict.rationale: Decagon is a SaaS AI customer-support platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any such opt-out. The nearest items are general mentions of 'visibility and control' over guardrails and 'data portability and control' of customer context, which are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
